emails.subject: Replacement card still not delivered
emails.body: I requested a replacement card on 30 October. The tracking page has not moved for a week. Please tell me where the card is.
emails.backend_status: Card dispatched 11 Nov; courier shows out for delivery 13 Nov.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. Your replacement card was dispatched on 11 November and the courier shows it out for delivery today, 13 November. We are sorry for the wait. We will send our final response once the card is delivered. If you are unhappy with it, you can refer your complaint to the Financial Ombudsman Service, free of charge, within 6 months of that response.

emails.subject: Payment failed but the money has left my account
emails.body: A Faster Payment failed on 10 November but the money was still taken from my account. It has not come back yet. I have already complained about this once.
emails.backend_status: Payment returned 12 Nov, 18:05, two days after the debit. Any redress for the delay: confirm with the bank.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The failed Faster Payment of 10 November was returned to your account on 12 November at 18:05. We are sorry it took longer than it should have. If the delay left you out of pocket, please reply to this email and we will look into it. This is our final response to your complaint. If you are unhappy with it, you can refer your complaint to the Financial Ombudsman Service, free of charge, within 6 months of the date of this response.

emails.subject: On behalf of the account holder: account restriction after identity check
emails.body: Writing on behalf of the account holder. Identity documents were submitted at the branch on 3 November. The account still shows as restricted. Please advise.
emails.backend_status: Identity check completed 12 Nov; restriction lifted 12 Nov, 17:30.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The identity documents were verified on 12 November and the restriction on the account was lifted the same day at 17:30. The account is now fully active. We will reply to the account holder's registered email as well. This is our final response to your complaint. If you are unhappy with it, you can refer your complaint to the Financial Ombudsman Service, free of charge, within 6 months of the date of this response.

emails.subject: My mortgage offer expires before completion
emails.body: My mortgage offer expires on 21 November and completion has slipped to December. Can the offer be extended?
emails.backend_status: Extension approved 12 Nov; new offer to be issued 14 Nov.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. Your mortgage offer has been extended to cover the new completion date, and the revised offer will be issued on 14 November. We will send it to you and to your solicitor. We will send our final response once the new offer is issued. If you are unhappy with it, you can refer your complaint to the Financial Ombudsman Service, free of charge, within 6 months of that response.

emails.subject: Redeemed a voucher but never received it
emails.body: I redeemed my reward points for a voucher on 6 November. The points have been taken but the voucher never arrived by email.
emails.backend_status: Voucher issued 12 Nov; resent to registered email.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The voucher you redeemed on 6 November was issued on 12 November and has been sent again to your registered email address. Please check your inbox, including the spam folder. We are sorry for the delay. This is our final response to your complaint. If you are unhappy with it, you can refer your complaint to the Financial Ombudsman Service, free of charge, within 6 months of the date of this response.

emails.subject: Card closure request ignored
emails.body: I asked for my credit card to be closed on 3 November. It is still active and I have been charged an annual fee.
emails.backend_status: Closure request open since 3 Nov; past the bank's closure standard (confirm with the bank). Fee refund and any redress: confirm with the bank.

emails.subject: Fraudulent transactions not refunded
emails.body: I reported two transactions I did not make on 11 November. I was told I would be refunded. Nothing yet.
emails.backend_status: Reported 11 Nov; refund due by the end of 12 Nov (PSRs 2017) and not yet credited.

emails.subject: Mortgage redemption statement delayed
emails.body: Writing for the borrower. The sale completes next week and the solicitor still has no redemption statement.
emails.backend_status: Requested 30 Oct; day 9 of the bank's 10-business-day standard (confirm with the bank).

emails.subject: Why has my account been frozen
emails.body: My current account, where my salary is paid, has suddenly been blocked for payments out. The branch told me to email. My rent and my mortgage repayment are both stuck.
emails.backend_status: Freeze review opened 10 Nov; no decision yet. Review standard: confirm with the bank.

emails.subject: Dispute raised in October, no update
emails.body: I disputed a charge on 1 October. Two follow-ups later, I have no update. I will take this to the Financial Ombudsman Service if it is not resolved.
emails.backend_status: No movement since 7 Oct; merchant response not chased. Final response due within 8 weeks of the complaint.

emails.subject: Complaint closed without resolution, third time
emails.body: This is the third time my complaint has been closed without anything being fixed. The charge is still on my statement.
emails.backend_status: Closed twice without reversal; charge still applied.

emails.subject: Wrong entry on my credit file
emails.body: My personal loan was repaid in July but my credit file still shows it as active. My mortgage application is stuck because of it.
emails.backend_status: Correction not sent to the credit reference agencies; day 30 of the 28-day industry dispute period.

emails.subject: Card application status
emails.body: I applied for a credit card two weeks ago. The status page says it is being processed. How much longer?
emails.backend_status: Checks complete; approval expected 14 Nov.

emails.subject: Refund still not received
emails.body: The merchant processed my refund on 4 November. It still has not reached my account.
emails.backend_status: Refund received from the card network 12 Nov; credit in the next posting run.

emails.subject: Payment to my builder not received
emails.body: I paid my builder by Faster Payment on Wednesday and he says the money has not arrived.
emails.backend_status: Payment held for a fraud check 11 Nov; released 12 Nov, 16:20; credited the same day.
